title: Run-log event record
description: One line of run_state/events.jsonl. Captures typed events distinct from per-call records (which live in logs/dayN.jsonl). Discriminated on event_type. Two members live here today: 'human_intervention' (P1) captures human action inside an otherwise-agent task; 'calibration_entry' (P3) captures the human's pre-experiment expected range vs the observed post-experiment value.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, UTC, when the intervention occurred.

task_id.description: Identifier of the agent_executable task in plan.yaml that was interrupted, e.g. 'day4_block2_e2e_test'.

subtype.description: Kind of intervention: edit_prompt (human rewrote a prompt), edit_code (human edited agent-written code), reject (human discarded an agent output), redirect (human steered the agent onto a different sub-path), manual_decision (human chose between options the agent surfaced).

reason.description: Free-text, human-supplied reason for the intervention.

context_hash.description: Hash of the task state at the moment of intervention; enables N generated / M survived / K edits accounting in the preprint.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, UTC, when the calibration entry was recorded.

experiment_id.description: Identifier of the experiment whose outcome is being calibrated, e.g. 'exp001_repeated_pd'.

metric_name.description: Name of the metric the human pre-stated a range for, e.g. 'coop_rate_vs_tft'.

pre_experiment_expected_range.description: [low, high] range elicited from the human BEFORE the experiment ran. Both elements are numbers; order is [low, high].

post_experiment_observed.description: Scalar value observed for metric_name once the experiment ran.

within_range.description: Whether post_experiment_observed fell inside pre_experiment_expected_range. Recorded explicitly so consumers do not have to re-derive it from the range.

human_attestation.description: Free-text attestation from the human who supplied the range, including any caveats about how it was chosen.
